name: Admin Resource
intent: Manage a set of resources (projects): find, compare, select and act.
user: Admin/operator managing a set of resources (projects).
primary_task: Find, select and act on resources; create new resources with validation.
secondary_tasks: Filter or search by name, status or owner
Delete an individual resource with confirmation
visual_vocabulary: Empty state (2 variants: no results / no records yet)
accessibility: <dialog open> server-rendered confirm with aria-labelledby / aria-describedby
content_rules: Buttons are action verbs (New project, Delete Alpha release)
Confirmation states what happens + irreversibility (cannot be undone)
Errors say what + how to resolve (Name is required.)

server_contract.notes: HX-Request bifurcates the #resource-panel fragment vs the full page. Mutations never use hx-post (R-NOJS-03).

no_js_flow: Complete: filter/sort/page/selection are real GET links (URL is state); create/edit/delete are native POST + 303; 422 re-renders the full page preserving values; delete confirm is a server-rendered <dialog open> with a real POST form; refresh reloads with an inline toast.
htmx_enhancement: hx-get swaps #resource-panel on sort/filter/page; refresh returns the fragment + HX-Trigger loom:toast. Mutations remain POST + 303 (no hx-post).
responsive_behavior: Fluid max-width column, no breakpoints; server-side pagination instead of horizontal table scroll; form grid with min()/clamp(); row actions stay inline links on narrow.
theme_requirements: Tokens --ui-* only; zero color literals (guard TestNoColorLiteralsInComponents); light/dark/forced-colors/reduced-motion by primitives; no new density or breakpoint tokens.
alternatives_rejected: Board: a filtered set, not a multi-lane workflow (R-DATA-03)
List for >8-10 rows: columnar comparison needs Data table (R-DATA-01)
Dialog for the full listing: page = URL/back (R-OVERLAY-01)
Toast for validation errors: 422 contract, persistent never transient (R-FEEDBACK-02)
rationale: Exercises the largest set of canonical contracts (GET params, selection, POST+303 destructive, Dialog confirm, 422, empty, toast, banner/inline persistent) over the most mature primitive (Data table); validates the recipe framework reused by Ops Queue and Public Feed.
